skill.summary: Materials editor workbench — React UI and Express server to render JSON schemas to images and generate schemas with AI (declare-render + materials-agents).

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the materials-workbench skill.
- Provides a local web app with a React frontend and Express backend for editing and rendering JSON schemas.
- Supports rendering schemas to images and AI-powered schema generation/editing via OpenAI.
- Requires OPENAI_API_KEY for AI features.
- Includes clear setup instructions and project structure.
